title: Native PDF drop onto a source's PDF slot (separate PDF-only read command)
description: From T149 (N4): in the native app a PDF dropped on a Research source's PDF slot is refused by src-tauri/src/dropped.rs (DROPPED_EXTENSIONS is the importer allow-list; MAX 20 MB; a test deliberately refuses Paper.pdf). Do NOT widen the importer allow-list or change that test. Add a separate narrowly scoped command (e.g. read_dropped_pdf) that applies the same guards (path must be in the latest drop, regular file not symlink, extension pdf only, size <= 25 MB per the plan, capped read) and wire the Research PDF-slot DropTarget's native path to it, calling onAttachPdf exactly like the picker path. Rust unit tests for accept pdf, refuse non-pdf, refuse oversize, refuse path not in drop, refuse symlink; frontend unit test for routing. Run cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --jobs 1 -- --test-threads=1 and UNIT; native drag itself is an owner hand-check (screen locked). Preserve-writing rules: attachment metadata must survive saves.

review.note: Approved. read_dropped_pdf shares read_guarded with the importer: path must be in latest drop, .pdf only (case-insensitive), symlink_metadata rejects symlinks and folders, fstat on the opened handle, 25 MB check plus take(max+1) capped read. DROPPED_EXTENSIONS and MAX_DROPPED_BYTES unchanged and a test pins pdf out of the list. Registered in both invoke handlers; no capability file change needed (read_dropped_file has none either). Frontend routes native paths to readDroppedPdf then onAttachPdf like the picker. cargo-full.log 63 passed, newer than sources; tsc 0 rerun. Minor: no ResearchPanel-level routing test (only readDroppedPdf unit tests); native GUI not run (owner hand-check).

Frontend: readDroppedPdf in src/import/dropImport.ts invokes read_dropped_pdf and returns a File (basename, type application/pdf); ResearchPanel PDF-slot DropTarget now calls readDroppedPdf then onAttachPdf exactly like the picker (App.attachPdf unchanged, so metadata/saves path unchanged); DropTarget.tsx untouched.
